It operates through Networking Platforms, Platform Software and Services, Blue Planet Automation Software and Services, and Global Services segments. The Networking Platforms segment consists optical networking, routing, and switching products and services. thesis: Ciena Corporation memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 52/100) dengan keunggulan utama di pertumbuhan (77) dan kesehatan keuangan (59). Titik lemahnya ada di valuasi (36).
